lineage_classes.OWNER_COMPLETE: All trigger rows, exact frozen checkpoints, source identity, event/retrieval/freeze timestamps and method hashes are present.
lineage_classes.OWNER_PARTIAL: Owner evidence exists for the trigger but one or more exact frozen checkpoints or availability fields are absent.
lineage_classes.BLOCKED: Candidate enumeration itself is prohibited because trigger or source-availability rules were not frozen before review.
lineage_classes.RETROACTIVELY_IRRECOVERABLE: Required point-in-time rows were never retained and cannot be reconstructed without substitution.
lineage_classes.RIGHT_CENSORED: A valid event lacks only future checkpoints not yet observable at the audit freeze.

family_findings.detail: Owner series may exist, but event construction is undefined and publication-vintage availability is not frozen.
Snapshots exist in the broader archive, but no preregistered stress threshold or propagation lag exists.
Settled trigger and rejection closes exist for one independent cluster; exact pre-event checkpoint history is incomplete.
No retained point-in-time constituent sidecar supports the known event; current-universe substitution is forbidden.
